name: Creeper
where: Overworld, anywhere the light level is 0 (night, caves, dark forests).
howToKill: Hit and retreat to stay out of its 3-block explosion trigger, or shoot it from a distance. A shield blocks most of the explosion if you raise it in time. Cats scare creepers away.

drops.notes: Key ingredient for TNT and firework rockets
Only when killed by a skeleton's arrow
Only when killed by a charged creeper's explosion

spawnConditions: Light level 0, on solid blocks in the Overworld. Does not spawn in mushroom fields.
behavior: Silently approaches players and detonates after 1.5 seconds within 3 blocks. Explosion power: 3 (charged by lightning: 6, twice as destructive).
keywords: creeper drops gunpowder explosion how to kill spawn

name: Zombie
where: Overworld at light level 0. Zombie villagers spawn instead of normal zombies 5% of the time.
howToKill: Any weapon works; it is slow and melee-only. Burns in sunlight unless wearing a helmet or standing in water or shade.

drops.notes: Emergency food; trade with cleric villagers
2.5% each, up to 5.5% with Looting III
Zombies wearing gear drop it (8.5% base for natural spawns)

spawnConditions: Light level 0. Sieges can spawn zombies around villages at midnight. Drowned convert from zombies that stay underwater.
behavior: Pursues players and villagers, breaks wooden doors on Hard difficulty, calls reinforcements when hurt (Java). Picks up items and wears armor.
tameOrBreed: Cannot be tamed or bred. Zombie villagers can be cured with Weakness + golden apple.
keywords: zombie drops rotten flesh iron how to kill spawn

name: Skeleton
where: Overworld at light level 0; also in Nether fortresses and soul sand valleys.
howToKill: Close the distance using cover or a shield, then melee. Their arrows are slow at short range but deadly in groups.

drops.notes: Bone meal for farms, taming wolves
Infinite arrows with a skeleton farm
8.5% drop chance, sometimes enchanted

spawnConditions: Light level 0 in the Overworld; light level 7 or less in Nether fortresses and soul sand valleys.
behavior: Shoots arrows from up to 16 blocks, strafes around targets (Java), burns in sunlight, retreats from wolves.
keywords: skeleton drops bones arrows how to kill spawn

name: Spider
where: Overworld at light level 0. Cave spiders spawn from spawners in mineshafts.
howToKill: Easy melee target; it jumps when attacking. In daylight it stops attacking unless provoked. Bane of Arthropods swords kill it fast.

drops.notes: Bows, fishing rods, wool, leads
Brewing ingredient; do not eat unless desperate

spawnConditions: Light level 0 in the Overworld, needs a 3x3x2 space but only a 1-block-high center.
behavior: Hostile below light level 12, neutral in daylight. Climbs walls and sees through blocks to track you.
keywords: spider drops string spider eye how to kill

name: Enderman
where: All three dimensions at light level 0; very common in the End and in warped forests.
howToKill: Fight under a 2-block-high roof: it is 3 blocks tall and cannot reach you. Attack its legs. It teleports away from arrows and water, so use melee.

drops.notes: Essential for Eyes of Ender to reach the End

spawnConditions: Light level 0 in the Overworld and Nether; light level 7 or less in the End.
behavior: Neutral until you look at its face (crosshair on its head) or attack it. Picks up and moves certain blocks. Takes damage from water.
keywords: enderman ender pearl how to kill teleport spawn

name: Warden
where: Deep Dark biome, summoned by sculk shriekers after 4 warnings. Spawns from the ground near the shrieker.
howToKill: You are not meant to fight it: sneak away and break the shriekers. If you must fight, it has no armor but huge health; its sonic boom ignores armor and shields. Killing it drops only a sculk catalyst - no real reward.

drops.notes: Spreads sculk when mobs die nearby; only drop

spawnConditions: Only via sculk shrieker activation (natural shriekers, 4 triggers), in the Deep Dark below Y=0.
behavior: Blind: hunts by sound and smell. Vibrations from walking, projectiles or blocks attract it. Sonic boom pierces walls and shields. Burrows away after 60 seconds of calm.
keywords: warden deep dark sculk shrieker how to kill sonic boom

name: Blaze
where: Nether fortresses, from spawners and natural spawns at light level 11 or less.
howToKill: Use a shield against its triple fireballs, or snowballs (they deal 3 damage each to blazes). A strength potion finishes them quickly. Fire Resistance removes most of the threat.

drops.notes: Brewing stands, fuel, Eyes of Ender - the gate to beating the game

spawnConditions: Nether fortresses, light level 11 or less. Spawners sit in small stairwell rooms.
behavior: Flies, shoots three fireballs in a burst, sets targets on fire on contact. Immune to fire and lava; takes extra damage from snowballs.
keywords: blaze rod nether fortress drops how to kill

name: Cow
where: Grassy biomes of the Overworld, in herds of up to 4. Needs grass and light level 9+ to spawn (Java).
howToKill: Any weapon; it runs when hit. Looting increases leather and beef drops.

drops.item: Raw Beef (Steak if killed by fire)
drops.notes: Cooked into steak: one of the best foods
Books, item frames, leather armor

spawnConditions: Grass blocks with light level 9 or higher (Java), 2 blocks of space. Also spawns with world generation.
behavior: Wanders, follows players holding wheat, can be milked with a bucket for infinite milk.
tameOrBreed: Breed two adults with wheat. Baby grows up in 20 minutes (faster if fed wheat).
keywords: cow drops leather beef breed milk farm

name: Pig
where: Grassy biomes of the Overworld, in herds. Common everywhere except snowy and badlands biomes.
howToKill: Any weapon; it flees when hurt. Kills by fire drop cooked porkchops directly.

drops.item: Raw Porkchop (Cooked if killed by fire)
drops.notes: Cooked porkchop is a top-tier food (8 hunger points)

spawnConditions: Grass blocks with light level 9 or higher (Java).
behavior: Wanders, follows players holding carrots, potatoes or beetroots. Can be saddled and steered with a carrot on a stick.
tameOrBreed: Breed two adults with carrots, potatoes or beetroots.
keywords: pig drops porkchop breed saddle ride

name: Wolf
where: Forests, taigas and groves, in packs of 4. Different variants per biome since 1.20.5.
howToKill: Wild wolves are neutral; attack one and the whole pack turns hostile. Tamed wolves teleport to you and fight for you.

drops.notes: Killing wolves gives no items

spawnConditions: Grass, snow or coarse dirt in forest-type biomes, light level 9+ (Java).
behavior: Neutral in packs: hurts one, hurts all. Tamed wolves follow, teleport to you, sit on command and attack your targets.
tameOrBreed: Tame with bones (each bone has a 1 in 3 chance). Breed two tamed wolves with any meat; the pup is born tamed.
keywords: wolf tame bones breed dog variants

name: Villager
where: Villages in plains, desert, savanna, taiga, snowy and meadow biomes. Zombie villagers appear at night anywhere.
howToKill: You should not: killing villagers drops your village popularity and iron golems will attack you. They have no drops and give only 1-3 XP.

drops.notes: Villagers drop no items; their value is trading

spawnConditions: Generate with villages and igloo basements; never spawn naturally afterwards - breed them or cure zombie villagers to repopulate.
behavior: Work at their job site block by day, gossip at the meeting point, sleep at night. Panic from zombies and raid mobs. 15 professions, each with its own trades.
tameOrBreed: Breed with food (3 bread or 12 carrots/potatoes/beetroots each) plus spare valid beds. Cure zombie villagers with a Weakness splash potion + golden apple for big trade discounts.
keywords: villager trades professions breed cure zombie villager

name: Shulker
where: End Cities in the outer End islands, camouflaged on walls and ceilings.
howToKill: Kill it while its shell is open to shoot - closed, it takes 80% less damage and deflects arrows. Melee with a sharp sword when it opens, or punch arrows back. Dodge the homing bullets or break them with any hit.

drops.qty: 0-1 (Java: 50%, +6.25% per Looting level; Bedrock: 0-1 up to 4 with Looting III)
drops.notes: Two shells + a chest = shulker box, the portable inventory

spawnConditions: Spawn once with End City generation and do not respawn naturally. A shulker hit by another shulker's bullet can duplicate (Java).
behavior: Stays disguised as a purpur block, opens to fire homing bullets that cause 10 seconds of levitation - deadly over the void. Teleports when hurt.
keywords: shulker shell end city levitation shulker box

name: Ender Dragon
where: The End dimension - the central island. Respawn it by placing 4 end crystals on the exit portal edges.
howToKill: Destroy the end crystals on the obsidian pillars first (shoot the exposed ones, pillar up to the caged ones) so it cannot heal. Then hit it with a bow while it flies and with a sword when it perches on the exit portal. Beds explode in the End: place one and detonate it as the dragon perches for massive damage. Bring Slow Falling or a water bucket for knockback.

drops.notes: The biggest XP drop in the game
First kill only, on top of the exit portal - trophy item

drops.item: Opens the exit portal + End Gateway
drops.notes: The gateway leads to the outer islands (elytra!)

spawnConditions: One dragon per End dimension; resummon with 4 end crystals arranged on each side of the exit portal.
behavior: Circles the island, breathes dragon's breath (area damage cloud), charges at players, and perches on the exit portal where it is immune to arrows. Heals from end crystals.
keywords: ender dragon how to kill end crystals boss fight

name: Wither
where: Spawned by the player anywhere: 4 soul sand or soul soil in a T shape with 3 wither skeleton skulls on top.
howToKill: Spawn it in a cramped bedrock ceiling (Java: under the exit portal fountain; Bedrock: a deep cave) so it cannot fly away. It is immune to arrows below half health - finish it with a Smite V sword. Bring strength potions, golden apples and milk to cure the Wither effect.

drops.notes: Crafts the beacon - the reason to fight it

spawnConditions: Player-built: T of soul sand/soil + 3 wither skeleton skulls (skull last). Wither skeleton skulls drop in Nether fortresses at 2.5% (5.5% with Looting III).
behavior: On spawn it charges up and explodes, then flies shooting explosive skulls that inflict the Wither effect (drains health, kills hearts). Breaks most blocks on contact. Below half health it gains a shield against projectiles (Java) or dashes and spawns wither skeletons (Bedrock).
keywords: wither boss how to spawn nether star beacon skulls

name: Axolotl
where: Lush caves, in water below Y=63 with clay nearby and total darkness. Five colors; blue only from breeding (1 in 1200).
howToKill: Do not - they are helpers. If you must know: they play dead when hurt, regenerating health.

drops.notes: No item drops

spawnConditions: Water in lush caves, light level 0, below Y=63, within 5 blocks of a clay block.
behavior: Swims, plays dead when damaged (regenerates), attacks fish, squid, drowned and guardians when led into battle with a bucket. Grants you Regeneration and removes Mining Fatigue for helping it fight.
tameOrBreed: Cannot be tamed but trusts players carrying tropical fish buckets. Breed two with a bucket of tropical fish. Carry it in a water bucket - it survives 5 minutes out of water.
keywords: axolotl lush caves blue axolotl bucket tame breed
